About us

About Zorko Group.
Built around people.

Zorko Limited brings together the people, systems, and expertise supporting our brands and business network. Explore the company behind the operations.

Who we are

A simple idea.
A shared direction.

Founded in Surat in 2020 by brothers Anand and Amrit Nahar, Zorko Limited connects corporate teams with a growing food-business network. The company’s work spans business development, operations, partner support, and the functions that help an organisation grow.

The name carries an encouragement familiar from home: “Zorko kaam karjo” — do your work with full power. Today, that spirit sits alongside the structure of a growing corporate team.

How we work

Good intentions.
Practical systems.

A food network depends on what happens behind the scenes. Our office connects business development, outlet support, training, creative work, procurement, finance, and governance.

Different teams bring their strengths to the same task: helping the business and the people around it move forward.

What guides us

The way we think.

01

Accessibility

Good vegetarian food should fit everyday life, including in smaller cities and towns.

02

Entrepreneurship

Local ownership and a connected support system sit at the heart of our franchise-led model.

03

Consistency

Recipes, training, supply coordination, and clear processes support the experience at each outlet.

04

People

Trust, shared learning, and a meaningful direction bring the team together.

Our journey

Small beginnings.
Lasting ambition.

A few chapters from the story
shared in Zorko Spotlight.

2020

The first chapter

The Nahar brothers begin Zorko in Surat.

2022–2023

Learning to grow

The magazine records 18+ outlets in 2022 and 72+ in 2023.

2024

A national stage

Zorko appears on Shark Tank India Season 3.

2025

Stronger foundations

The publication records 284+ outlets as the organisation develops.

2026

A wider world

The November edition reports 550+ outlets, dedicated teams, and new partnerships.
